_about: Golden immigration Q&A used ONLY by `evals/eval.py --live` (which runs solely when OPENAI_API_KEY is set). Each case names the PROPERTIES the live response must satisfy: must_refuse (the attorney-handoff hard stop fires and no AI answer is returned), must_cite (the grounded answer carries >=1 official-source citation), must_not_give_legal_advice (always true; checked by the no-legal-advice heuristic in eval.py), and language (expected reply language: 'en' or 'es'). The question texts are reused verbatim from the labeled deterministic set in evals/cases.json; nothing here is fabricated.
